reason: Pre-capture statistical review found that fallback level B stated a weighted-average denominator rather than the standard weighted interval score normalization. The implementation and reporting should use the established WIS definition of Bracher, Ray, Gneiting, and Reich.
primary_scoring_effect: Fallback-B WIS values are rescaled to the standard definition. This cannot change the ElectionSimulator-versus-Botten-Ada ranking or winner because both are scored on the same common interval levels and therefore share the same positive denominator. Draw-based primary fair CRPS is unchanged.

replacement_rule.standard_wis_formula: For K common central intervals with miscoverage alpha_k and median m, WIS = (0.5*|y-m| + sum_k (alpha_k/2)*IS_alpha_k)/(K+0.5).
replacement_rule.selection: Use all and only the non-empty intersection of levels explicitly published by both models for all eight parties; never interpolate missing quantiles.

reference.citation: Bracher J, Ray EL, Gneiting T, Reich NG. Evaluating epidemic forecasts in an interval format. PLOS Computational Biology (2021; corrected 2022).
